answer_2.quote: As evaluation metrics we report the precision (P), recall (R), and F 1 (mean and std), of exact match predictions.

answer_4.quote: One of the authors categorized these predictions into one of four options: invalid target, correct target identified with wrong sentiment or span, borderline target that can be accepted, and a clearly correct target.
